name: Somerset County, Maryland (United States)
description: The flag of Great Britain charged at the centre with the head of a Native American in a white octagon.
history: Somerset County is the southernmost county of Maryland. English Wikipedia records that the flag was adopted in 1694 after the county received a royal warrant from King William III to use the Union Jack as its flag; the present form carries the Union Flag of 1801 with a Native American's head at the centre.

features.role: saltire of St Andrew with the red saltire of St Patrick
octagon bearing the head of a Native American
